purpose: Validate the repaired V5 roster, preserve unaffected Batch 1-3 event research, invalidate only previously researched slots whose identity changed, and emit a fixed re-research worklist before Batch 4 resumes.

validation.selected_identity_rule: Every DEV and CONFIRM selected slot must be PASS_EXACT_DOB.

sanitization.drop_rule: Drop all prior event/audit rows whose subject_id is in V5_EVENT_RESEARCH_INVALIDATED_SLOTS.csv.
sanitization.retain_rule: Keep every other previously collected Batch 1-3 row unchanged.

resume_gate.after_18C: Only fixed re-research slots may be researched.
resume_gate.after_reresearch_merge_and_validation: Batch 4 may resume using repaired Batch 04 subject file.
